ValidationRule.description: If the picklist value "Other" is selected for the field "Level of Security Clearance Required" on the TTS Opportunity page, the "Other Level of Security Clearance Required" field is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', ISBLANK( Other_Level_of_Security_Clearance_Requir__c ), ISPICKVAL( Level_of_Security_Clearance_Required__c , 'other') ), AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', NOT (ISBLANK( Other_Level_of_Security_Clearance_Requir__c )), NOT (ISPICKVAL( Level_of_Security_Clearance_Required__c , 'other')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill out " Other Level of Security Clearance Required" only if "Other" was chosen as Level of Security Clearance Required field. If you did not choose "Other", leave it blank
